title: Beyond GRPO and On-Policy Distillation: An Empirical Sparse-to-Dense Reward Principle for Language-Model Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.12483v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In settings where labeled verifiable training data is the binding constraint, each checked example should be allocated to the model and reward density where it is most informative. We identify a reward-density principle: sparse sequence-level reward is most useful on models that can explore and discover better behavior, while dense token-level teacher supervision is better suited for compressing that behavior into a smaller deployment model; accordingly, scarce labeled data should be used upstream on the strongest available teacher, then transferred downstream as dense supervision. We evaluate this rule through a four-stage workflow:teacher RL, forward-KL warmup, on-policy distillation, optional post-bridge student RL on verifiable math and code generation with Qwen3, Llama, and Qwen2.5 models. translated_title: 超越GRPO与在线策略蒸馏：一种用于语言模型后训练的稀疏到密集奖励经验原则
translated_abstract: 在可验证标注训练数据成为瓶颈约束的场景中，每个经过校验的样本都应被分配到信息价值最大的模型与奖励密度上。我们提出了一个奖励密度原则：稀疏的序列级奖励对那些能够探索并发现更优行为的模型最为有用，而密集的词元级教师监督则更适合将这种行为压缩到较小的部署模型中；因此，稀缺的标注数据应在上游用于最强的可用教师模型，然后作为密集监督向下游传递。我们通过一个四阶段工作流来评估该原则：教师模型强化学习、前向KL预热、在线策略蒸馏，以及在可验证数学与代码生成任务上可选的桥接后学生模型强化学习，实验使用Qwen3、Llama和Qwen2.5模型。在固定的Qwen3-1.7B部署学生模型规模下，经由密集桥接蒸馏的、经强化学习改进的8B教师模型，其表现优于直接GRPO……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个“稀疏到密集”的奖励密度经验原则——稀疏的序列级强化学习奖励应在上游用于最强的教师模型以充分探索，再通过密集的词元级蒸馏监督将教师行为压缩传递给小型部署学生模型，并通过四阶段工作流在数学与代码生成任务上验证了该原则优于直接GRPO训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an empirical sparse-to-dense reward principle—sparse sequence-level RL rewards work best upstream on strong teacher models for exploration, while dense token-level supervision transfers teacher behavior to smaller deployment students via distillation—validated through a four-stage workflow that outperforms direct GRPO on math and code generation tasks.
